## raw salmon data

Pull in raw beach seine data and filter to select "good" sites and focus on Chinook salmon.

```{r}

raw <- read_rds(here("salmon/data/raw/raw.rds"))

# list of beach seine station codes identified minimally adequate for 
# temporal coverage
good <- 
  tibble(station = read_rds(here("salmon/data/processed/selected_site_codes.rds")))

# select data from those minimum effort sites and 
# for complete water years (1976-10-01 onwards)
dat <-
  raw %>% 
  filter(station %in% good$station,
         # limit to data collected during complete water years
         date >= "1976-10-01") %>% 
  mutate(year = year(date),
         month = month(date)) %>% 
  relocate(region, .after = id_code) %>% 
  relocate(year:month, .before = date) %>% 
  # add water year (wy) and day of water year (wd) variables
  mutate(
    # water year
    wy = dataRetrieval::calcWaterYear(date),
    # day of water year (wd), wyMonth=10L bc water year begins Oct 1
    wd = EflowStats::get_waterYearDay(date, wyMonth = 10L)) %>% 
  # reorg & select columns
  relocate(wy:wd, .after = date) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(
    station:water_temp, organism_code, fork_length, race_by_length, count)) %>% 
  # add 'sample_id' to identify each unique seine event
  group_by(date, time, station) %>% 
  mutate(sample_id = cur_group_id()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  relocate(sample_id) %>% 
  mutate(org_code = if_else(organism_code == "CHN", "CHN", "NOFISH"),
         # set fork_length = NA for NOFISH rows
         fork_length = if_else(org_code == "NOFISH", NA_real_, fork_length),
         # set count = 0 for NOFISH rows
         count = if_else(org_code == "NOFISH", 0L, count)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(
    sample_id:location, date:wd, water_temp, org_code, 
    fork_length, race_by_length, count)) %>% 
  ungroup()


```

### pivot wide

```{r}


salmon <- dat %>%
  # force to character to ensure exact matching in pivot_wider
  mutate(org_code = as.character(org_code)) %>%
  # group by all identifier columns
  group_by(sample_id, station, location, date, wy, wd, water_temp, org_code) %>%
  summarise(
    total_count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_length = sum(!is.na(fork_length)),
    mean_length = mean(fork_length, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_length = sd(fork_length, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # pivot using explicit names
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = org_code,
    values_from = c(total_count, n_length, mean_length, sd_length)
  ) %>%
  # replace NAs in the Chinook count column with 0 if needed
  mutate(total_count_CHN = replace_na(total_count_CHN, 0)) %>% 
  # have sample_id's where total_count_CHN = 0, so 'NOFISH' is unneeded
  dplyr::select(-ends_with("NOFISH"))

# verify CHN counts
sum(salmon$total_count_CHN, na.rm = TRUE)


```

## size over time

Re-summarise salmon data to collect individual FLs for each water year, limited to days prior to the 10% benchmark.

```{r}

pctl10_days_wyt <-
  read_rds(here("salmon/data/processed/pctl_days_wyt.rds")) %>% 
  filter(percentile == "day_10")

# join the datasets by Water Year (wy)
chn_subset <- dat %>%
  filter(org_code == "CHN") %>%
  inner_join(
    pctl10_days_wyt %>% 
      dplyr::select(wy, threshold_wd = wd, wyt), by = "wy") %>%
  # filter for fish that arrived on or before the 10th percentile day
  filter(wd <= threshold_wd)

# check on summary code
chn_subset %>%
  group_by(wy) %>%
  summarise(
    max_day_captured = max(wd),
    threshold_was = first(threshold_wd),
    n_fish = n()
  )

# calc means by Water Year and Type
fork_length_summary <- 
  chn_subset %>%
  group_by(wy, wyt) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_fl = mean(fork_length, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_fl = sd(fork_length, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_fish = n(),
    se_fl = sd_fl / sqrt(n_fish), # SE for error bars
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  # remove wy 2025 bc no year type designation yet
  filter(wyt != is.na(wyt))

# view summary
print(fork_length_summary) %>% print(n = 55)

fork_length_summary %>% 
ggplot(aes(x = wy, y = mean_fl, color = wyt)) +
  geom_line(color = "gray80", group = 1) + # line to show temporal connection
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_fl - se_fl, 
                    ymax = mean_fl + se_fl), 
                width = 0.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  # apply reversed (drier are lighter) color scale for ordered year types
  scale_color_viridis_d(direction = -1) + 
  labs(
    title = "Mean Fork Length of Early Migrating Chinook (First 10%)",
    x = "Water Year",
    y = "Mean Fork Length (+/- SE, mm)",
    color = "Year Type"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

size_lr <- lm(mean_fl ~ wy, data = fork_length_summary)
summary(size_lr)
# nothing!

fork_length_summary %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = wyt, y = mean_fl, fill = wyt)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  # show individual years as dots
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 2) + 
  # add this line to reverse the fill colors
  scale_fill_viridis_d(direction = -1) + 
  labs(
    title = "Annual Outmigrant Chinook Fork Lengths by Water Year Type",
    subtitle = "first 10% of that year's cohort",
    x = "Water Year Type",
    y = "Fork Length (mm)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(fill = "none") # remove legend since X axis covers it

fork_length_summary %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = wyt, y = mean_fl, fill = wyt)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.7) +
  # show individual years as dots
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 2) + 
  # add this line to reverse the fill colors
  scale_fill_viridis_d(direction = -1) + 
  labs(
    title = "Annual Outmigrant Chinook Fork Lengths by Water Year Type",
    subtitle = "first 10% of that year's cohort",
    x = "Water Year Type",
    y = "Fork Length (mm)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(fill = "none") # remove legend since X axis covers it

# test for significant differences between Water Year Types
anova_res <- aov(mean_fl ~ wyt, data = fork_length_summary)
summary(anova_res)
# no surprise here...

```
